prompt:
Cinematic atmospheric photograph, 16:9 widescreen.
Composition: warm over-the-counter shallow-depth perspective inside a modern Korean neighborhood specialty cafe at dusk. In the right foreground on a dark walnut wood counter sits a condensation-beaded iced Americano cup next to a sleek black card payment terminal, catching warm golden tungsten pendant light. Behind it, an espresso machine and a softly blurred barista preparing a drink dissolve into rich creamy warm-amber bokeh.
Mood & lighting: cozy moody low-key lighting with deep rich shadows across the left and bottom for clean subtitle legibility, subtle natural film grain, 50mm f/1.8 lens.
No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no brand logos, no watermarks, no sparkle icons anywhere. Ultra-clean edges.
